label: LC/APC connector pair
notes: 0.25 dB is a typical loss for a mated LC/APC pair, not a figure taken from one datasheet. IEC 61753-1 grades random-mated single-mode connectors by attenuation: grade B is 0.12 dB mean and 0.25 dB max, grade C is 0.25 dB mean and 0.50 dB max, so this row's 0.25 dB typical and 0.5 dB ceiling are grade C mean and grade C max - 0.25 is the top of grade B, not its typical, and until 2026-11-27 this note credited the row with grade B's typical, which is not what a commodity LC/APC pair is sold to. The grade-B part is lc-apc-lowloss (0.15 typical, 0.25 ceiling); this row stays at 0.25 because a randomly mated field pair sits at grade C, and charging grade B's 0.12 mean here would under-predict half the plant. Small-form-factor connector used in OLT line cards and ODF panels. The engine charges one connector per mating. Replace with the loss measured on the patch cords you buy.
